## Philips N4520 Player v0.0.12

### Changed
- Reworked reel animation so tape-pack changes update reel velocity only; reel position is advanced from the prior frame instead of being driven by CSS animation phase changes.
- Moved the left-reel sticker center 20px to the right and rotated it 25 degrees further around its center.

### Validation
- Passed JavaScript syntax checks for the app and HACS card bundle.
- Verified the HACS card source and distributed bundle match.
